verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB documents that the `s3()` table function works as documented (obsessiondb-docs-36/45) on the official ClickHouse engine (obsessiondb-probe-2), so it can read files in object storage directly. However, this appears only in the ingestion docs, framed as a way to load data, not as in-place querying. Missing for 10: any mention of Iceberg or Delta Lake table support, explicit Parquet format support, documentation of querying external data in place without loading it into MergeTree storage, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
